projects.name: Codem Convertor
projects.description: An epic tool to convert your Music and vids over from yt. With the addition of an in app music tester. You'll need ffmpeg - grab it straight from the link in settings or download from https://www.ffmpeg.org/download.html. V1=Music Player/Downloader, V2=Loops/Spins, V3=Playlists/Thumbnails, V4=Local API, Port Management & App Manipulation, V5=Auto Updated Module added to fix crashing & Auto download updates.
